When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

This meeting is over. I'm leaving.
It isn't over, Hale. You entered a zero on my son without calling me, and I'm not leaving without an answer. Sit down, or I go to the principal's office from here.

Then I'm going to the principal's office next, Hale. I'll want the zero withdrawn and your reason for entering it in an email tonight. I'm writing down that you ended this meeting before answering me.
Because you haven't answered me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in? Answer that and I'll stop.
